overview.description: The Principal Investment Grade Corporate ETF (IG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in investment grade fixed income. The fund is an actively managed fund that provides current income by selecting investment-grade, USD-denominated bonds of any maturity. IG was launched on Apr 18, 2018 and is issued by Principal.
